title: Concatenated continuous driving of silicon qubit by amplitude and phase modulation
summary: The rate of coherence loss is lower for a qubit under the Rabi drive than a freely evolving qubit $T_{2}^{\rm{Rabi}}>T_{2}^*$. Building on this principle, concatenated continuous driving (CCD) keeps the qubit under continuous drive to suppress noise and manipulate dressed states by either phase or amplitude modulation. In this work, we propose a variant of CCD which simultaneously modulates both the amplitude and phase of the driving field to generate a circularly polarized field in the rotating frame of the carrier frequency.
